def transform(grid):
    # The zero rectangle marks a missing patch. Recover it from the vertically
    # mirrored rows across the center of the 24x24 patterned grid.
    zeros = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    if not zeros:
        return []
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in zeros), max(r for r, c in zeros)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in zeros), max(c for r, c in zeros)
    return [[grid[len(grid)-1-r][c] for c in range(c0, c1+1)] for r in range(r0, r1+1)]
